title: Schönbrunn ~$47 vs China's Summer Palace ~$7 — Which Palace? | China Travel Expert
description:
Two imperial palaces, two very different prices. Vienna's Schönbrunn Palace runs about $47 for the full interior tour. Beijing's Summer Palace — the Qing emperors' lakeside retreat — costs about $7 for the all-access through-ticket. Same kind of grand palace-and-gardens day out, for roughly six times less.

Schönbrunn gives you the state rooms and formal gardens. The Summer Palace gives you a vast imperial garden wrapped around Kunming Lake, with halls, temples and a famous painted corridor. So which palace would you rather spend a day in?

🧭 Expert Tip: at the Summer Palace, buy the ¥50 off-season through-ticket (联票), not the ¥20 gate ticket — only the through-ticket opens the Tower of Buddhist Incense, Suzhou Street and the other inner halls.

维也纳美泉宫全程票约 $47，北京颐和园通票约 $7——差不多六倍。同样是皇家园林宫殿，你选哪座？
